title: Rewiring America Heat Pump Incentives: What You’re Missing!
summary: An HVAC contractor-advocate describes a nonprofit's vetted-contractor heat pump program and the importance of load calculations, air sealing and correct installation.

assertions.quote: Your power consumption is going to be greater. You're not going to be comfortable
I mean you really don't want to put a heat pump on a leaky house.
What the homeowners got out of that though was typically about a 20% discount on what they could have got on the street.

verdicts.note: The discount figure is self-reported by the program and not independently measured.

LBNL: the CEE program's fixed contractor network working at pre-agreed costs 'reduces measure costs' and keeps comprehensive projects low-cost, and the PAYS program with fixed contractor networks and streamlined scopes also lowered costs (observational program comparison).

assertions.quote: I caught my system on a 16 degree morning that was maintaining 70 on the stat and producing 17,640 BTUs

verdicts.note: Field reports show variable-speed units covering full load at moderate design temperatures, but not in very cold climates or leaky homes.

Sizing variable-speed and cold-climate units to the full design heating load is common practice in some programs, but for many homes duct airflow limits (about 3 tons) or the 5-ton maximum ducted size make it impractical without envelope upgrades.
The only two heat pumps sized above the design load met over 95% of the season heating load by compressor, but still used some auxiliary heat (lowering COP by under 7%), so not fully without backup.

Variable-speed units sized with Manual J still used some auxiliary heat at 0-10 F at seven sites, partly because of setbacks; the appendix shows units sized near the load with resistance heat making up the gap to peak.

assertions.quote: most people don't realize inverters defrost really well and pretty quickly as compared to a, you know, a standard conventional style

verdicts.note: Defrost behaviour varies by control strategy; no independent comparison is widely available.

assertions.quote: Or it may be in an area where gas is just really cheap and it also makes sense.
especially in my area where it's propane laden, right? We have a lot of propane and it's expensive.
